The plate is a square plate of roughly 24 cm. The food is a pile of fresh spinach leaves with a few bits of broccoli, some red pepper strips, and a few small pieces of what looks like cheese or nuts.

The pile covers about 10 x 14 cm and is a few leaves thick. Whole spinach leaves weigh about 0.5 to 1 g each, so 40 to 60 leaves come to about 40 g. The broccoli, pepper and other bits add roughly 15 to 20 g, for about 55 to 60 g in total.

Spinach is about 23 kcal per 100 g, so 40 g gives roughly 10 kcal. The extras add around 15 kcal. I'll allow a little more for possible dressing or oil, which gives about 35 kcal in all.
